# Isaiah Chapter 2 -- The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full dynamic translation of all 22 verses in natural contemporary English]*

*Eschatological vision of Zion exalted; nations streaming to God; Day of the LORD against human pride*

---

## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

**The Mountain of the LORD:** Eschatological vision of Zion exalted; nations streaming to God; Day of the LORD against human pride. The key message for modern readers: "They shall beat their swords into plowshares"

*-- PNEUMA*
